title: Twitter Performance Analysis - Jan 31st - Aug 30th 2022
body:
Below is an Performance Overview of our Twitter posts for Edgeware
Continued thank you to Gagan for the monthly recording and posting of our data...

Please see the link for his excel report: [https://onedrive.live.com/view.aspx?resid=4326C4CAE1B046BA!35406&ithint=file%2cxlsx&authkey=!AOfEK026AJmRO8g](https://onedrive.live.com/view.aspx?resid=4326C4CAE1B046BA!35406&ithint=file%2cxlsx&authkey=!AOfEK026AJmRO8g)

The visual below, is a overview of our Twitter Performance categorized and compared by the following:

· **Average Engagement Rate**
· **Replies & Quotes**
· **Retweets**
· **URL Clicks**
· **Profile Clicks**
· **Favorites**
· **Engagements**
· **Impressions**


![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/eefbadef-79de-4450-bfaf-fe815f54adfb.1663733709321)

Since June...
Our overall Engagement Rate% has increased from _3.54%_ to _3.76%_

1. Tweets related our **Features,** continues to leads our _Engagement rate. _
2. Tweets related to our **Services** provided and upcoming, leads our _Replies, Quotes and Retweets._
3. Tweets related to our **Operations ** we provide leads our _URL, Profile clicks and Total Engagements _



![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/1806aad5-c824-44bb-a114-ef377995442d.1663734469967)

Above is a comparison of our _Impressions** ** _by Type.



![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/6306114a-10dd-41b7-a0e9-78506d3686c9.1663734625367)

Above is a comparison of our _Engagements_ by Type.



![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/361ab3db-f9af-4f12-92dd-042f87f2af1a.1663734661398)


Notable: Despite July's slight decrease in _**Impressions**_, our DAO increased our average engagement rate from approx _3.6% _to _4.4%. _

1. [June-July] Monthly **_Impression_ **decrease: _2,559_
2. [June-July] Monthly _**Impression**_ decrease: _24,909_



Note: January 31st is omitted from this visual
Outlier Data: [_Impressions _- 1,419] [_Engagement_ - 72] [_Engagement Rat
